text.arabic_uthmani: وَإِذْ بَوَّأْنَا لِإِبْرَٰهِيمَ مَكَانَ ٱلْبَيْتِ أَن لَّا تُشْرِكْ بِى شَيْـًۭٔا وَطَهِّرْ بَيْتِىَ لِلطَّآئِفِينَ وَٱلْقَآئِمِينَ وَٱلرُّكَّعِ ٱلسُّجُودِ

words.gloss_range: resumptive and coordinating connector opening a recalled founding scene
words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) opens 22:26 as connected recall. It keeps the threat and sacred-precinct discourse of 22:25 in view while moving into the founding scene, so the Abrahamic commission reads as evidence for the House’s sanctity rather than as a disconnected notice.

topics.headline: recalled charter bridge
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the opening connector makes the Abrahamic founding scene support the sacred-precinct warning in 22:25 instead of starting an unrelated report.
topics.reason: The aligned word is the opening conjunction, and the following temporal clause recalls the founding assignment after the 22:25 sacred-space threat.

words.gloss_range: past-time recall particle that frames the divine placement as remembered charter
words.prose: {{ar:إِذْ}} ({{tr:idh}}) turns the ayah into a recalled founding moment, not mere chronology. It invites the listener back to the divine assignment, and its frame resembles the Abraham-House opening in 2:125 while 22:26 uses placement language rather than making language.

topics.headline: temporal recall frame
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah asks the founding moment to be remembered as the ground for the present sanctuary claim.
topics.reason: The temporal particle opens a past-time frame and is compatible with the familiar implied-recall construction.

topics.headline: Abrahamic House formula
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the formulaic link with the House assignment in 2:125 while still seeing that this ayah chooses a different founding verb.
topics.reason: The row evidence explicitly compares the frame with 2:125; the echo is structural, while the local verb remains distinct.

words.gloss_range: Form II divine placement or settlement of {{ar:إِبْرَٰهِيمَ}} ({{tr:ibrāhīma}}) at the House site
words.root_gloss_range: broad {{ar:ب و أ}} ({{tr:b-w-ʾ}}) range of returning, settling, abode, and consequence; locally narrowed to causative settlement/designation
words.prose: {{ar:بَوَّأْنَا}} ({{tr:bawwaʾnā}}) makes God the one who deliberately settles or assigns, with the site noun as the object and the named patriarch as the commissioned recipient. The rare {{ar:ب و أ}} ({{tr:b-w-ʾ}}) field gives the act an abode-and-return texture, while local Form II grammar keeps the sense to causative placement rather than the root’s punishment-return branch. Its first-person plural ending embeds the divine “We” before the later direct singular “with Me” and “My House” language. The verb also echoes the Abraham-House frame of 2:125, but with settlement as the chosen aspect.

topics.headline: recipient separate from site
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that {{ar:إِبْرَٰهِيمَ}} ({{tr:ibrāhīma}}) receives a commission at the site while the site itself is the object of divine placement.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence confirms the recipient through the preceding preposition and the direct object as the site phrase.

topics.headline: deliberate settlement root
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the {{ar:ب و أ}} ({{tr:b-w-ʾ}}) root makes the founding act feel like deliberate settlement at an abode, while consequence and wrath branches remain only background range.
topics.reason: Form II locally selects causative placement or settlement; broader return-with-consequence branches inform range but do not govern the local sense.

topics.headline: divine speaker inside the verb
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that {{ar:بَوَّأْنَا}} ({{tr:bawwaʾnā}}) grammatically embeds the divine “We” before the later direct singular possessives appear.
topics.reason: The first-person plural suffix is part of the finite verb form.

topics.headline: House placement parallel
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that 22:26 recasts the Abraham-House scene known from 2:125 as site-settlement, not simply institutional making.
topics.reason: The source rows explicitly connect 22:26 with 2:125 and with the preceding sacred-space boundary.

words.gloss_range: dative-benefactive preposition marking {{ar:إِبْرَٰهِيمَ}} ({{tr:ibrāhīma}}) as recipient of the assignment
words.prose: {{ar:لِ}} ({{tr:li}}) makes the named patriarch the recipient-beneficiary of the divine placement. Because the phrase comes before the object, the commission is heard before the site: the House’s place is assigned for his role, not with him as the object being placed.

topics.headline: commissioning recipient marker
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the site is assigned for and to {{ar:إِبْرَٰهِيمَ}} ({{tr:ibrāhīma}}), foregrounding his commissioned role before the place is named.
topics.reason: The preposition governs the proper name as recipient or beneficiary before the direct object appears.

words.gloss_range: foreign proper name marking the commissioned human recipient
words.prose: {{ar:إِبْرَٰهِيمَ}} ({{tr:ibrāhīma}}) is not mined here for an Arabic root; it anchors the commission in a named patriarchal recipient. Its marked proper-name form keeps the figure specific, while the ayah’s later commands depend on him as the recovered second-person addressee. The same name links this commission to the House material in 2:125-127 and to the ancestral frame in 22:78.

topics.headline: marked proper name
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices a specific named patriarchal recipient rather than an Arabic root-derived title or generic founder.
topics.reason: The word is tagged as a foreign proper noun and is governed by the preceding preposition.

topics.headline: founder and ancestral model
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the addressee in the House commission is also the ancestral model later invoked in 22:78 and in the House traditions of 2:125-127.
topics.reason: The rows supply concrete links to 22:78 and 2:125-127.

topics.headline: named command recipient
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the coming second-person commands are anchored to a named recipient, not left as free-floating instruction.
topics.reason: The proper name appears before the embedded command content, and attachment evidence recovers {{ar:إِبْرَٰهِيمَ}} ({{tr:ibrāhīma}}) as the addressee.

words.gloss_range: direct-object site of the House, concrete rather than abstract rank
words.root_gloss_range: broad {{ar:ك و ن}} ({{tr:k-w-n}}) being/existence range narrowed to noun-of-place sitehood
words.prose: {{ar:مَكَانَ}} ({{tr:makāna}}) is the object God assigns, so the wording highlights the site itself before any focus on the built structure. As a {{ar:ك و ن}} ({{tr:k-w-n}}) place noun it gives existence a location, but the construct with the following House noun keeps the local sense concrete: the site of the known House, not an abstract status. This also names the sacred place whose violation was threatened in 22:25.

topics.headline: site as direct object
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that God designates the place itself, so sacred geography precedes any focus on the built structure.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence makes the place noun the direct object of the placement verb.

topics.headline: House-specified site
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the {{ar:ك و ن}} ({{tr:k-w-n}}) place form turns being into located sacred site, while the construct with the House blocks an abstract rank reading.
topics.reason: The construct with the definite House selects concrete sitehood; broader existence/rank range is narrowed locally.

topics.headline: prior precinct named as site
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the place threatened against in 22:25 is now named as the divinely assigned site of the House.
topics.reason: Boundary rows connect the prior sacred precinct references with the explicit site phrase in 22:26.

words.gloss_range: the known sanctuary, genitive specifier of the site phrase
words.root_gloss_range: broad {{ar:ب ي ت}} ({{tr:b-y-t}}) dwelling, shelter, night-return, and structured-unit range narrowed to the sacred House
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلْبَيْتِ}} ({{tr:al-bayti}}) makes the site belong to a known House. The {{ar:ب ي ت}} ({{tr:b-y-t}}) range supplies dwelling and return texture, but the article and sanctuary context select the sacred House. This first mention anticipates purification and circumambulation, sets up the ayah’s ownership arc from known House to “My House,” and lets the worship field continue into 22:29.

topics.headline: known sanctuary in construct
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the House is treated as already identifiable and sacred, not introduced as an unknown building.
topics.reason: The definite genitive noun specifies the preceding construct head and selects the sanctuary referent.

topics.headline: dwelling-return background
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the {{ar:ب ي ت}} ({{tr:b-y-t}}) dwelling and return texture behind the sanctuary, while the local article and context keep the referent as the known House.
topics.reason: Broader house, night-stay, and structure senses are valid root range but locally narrow to sanctuary.

topics.headline: House and worship field
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the first House mention already anticipates purification and circumambulation, including the later circumambulation command in 22:29.
topics.reason: The rows explicitly link the House root with purification and circumambulation fields, including 22:29.

topics.headline: known House to My House
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices an internal movement from the known House to “My House,” so identifiability becomes divine possession later in the ayah.
topics.reason: The same root appears again with a first-person possessive suffix at word 15.

words.gloss_range: subordinating particle opening the commission’s command content
words.prose: {{ar:أَنْ}} ({{tr:an}}) is the hinge from placement report to command content. It lets the founding act be explained by what follows: first the prohibition of association, then the purification command. The particle also carries a light objective pressure, making non-association not just quoted speech but the commission’s first aim.

topics.headline: commission content hinge
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the turn from site assignment into the actual command content of the commission.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence treats the following prohibition and command as content governed by the placement verb.

topics.headline: explicative and objective pressure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the particle both explains what the commission says and can package non-association as the commission’s foundational objective.
topics.reason: The source rows preserve both explicative and verbal-noun-like readings without contradiction.

words.gloss_range: prohibitive negator governing the jussive association verb
words.prose: {{ar:لَّا}} ({{tr:lā}}) makes the first instruction prohibitive. Its force is not only negative; with the jussive verb and the following indefinite object, it excludes any possible thing from partnership. The ayah then moves from this ban into the positive command to purify.

topics.headline: prohibitive mood control
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the first command is built as a prohibition through negation and jussive mood, not as a mere report.
topics.reason: The following verb is jussive after the negating particle with command force.

topics.headline: total exclusion with anything
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the negator only reaches full force with the indefinite object: no possible thing is exempt from the partnership ban.
topics.reason: The negator combines with the indefinite object at word 12 to produce total prohibitive scope.

topics.headline: negate then purify
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the command sequence: false association is barred before the House is positively purified.
topics.reason: The prohibition is complete before the later coordinated purification imperative.

words.gloss_range: Form IV jussive prohibition: do not assign any partner to God
words.root_gloss_range: broad {{ar:ش ر ك}} ({{tr:sh-r-k}}) range of sharing, partnership, and snare imagery narrowed to prohibited theological association
words.prose: {{ar:تُشْرِكْ}} ({{tr:tushrik}}) shifts the scene into direct address to the named patriarch. Its Form IV shape makes the forbidden act the assigning of partnership, and the local phrase with the divine pronoun selects morally charged association rather than neutral sharing. The root’s snare image adds a trapping pressure to that association, while local grammar keeps the selected sense theological. The same prohibition is later unfolded in 22:31 as the collapse of one who associates partners; here the clipped jussive ending gives the ban a hard stop before the positive command to purify.

topics.headline: direct second-person address
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the shift from divine narration to direct speech addressed to {{ar:إِبْرَٰهِيمَ}} ({{tr:ibrāhīma}}).
topics.reason: The canonical form is second-person masculine singular jussive with {{ar:إِبْرَٰهِيمَ}} ({{tr:ibrāhīma}}) as recovered subject; variants are useful contrast but do not replace the canonical address.

topics.headline: assigned partnership act
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the {{ar:ش ر ك}} ({{tr:sh-r-k}}) verb prohibits actively assigning partnership to God, not neutral sharing.
topics.reason: Form IV and the local negated relation with the divine pronoun select morally charged association rather than neutral partnership.

topics.headline: snare image background
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices a concrete trapping pressure in the {{ar:ش ر ك}} ({{tr:sh-r-k}}) field, while local grammar keeps the selected sense as theological association.
topics.reason: The snare branch is valid lexical background but does not override the local Form IV association sense.

topics.headline: same-surah consequence arc
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the founding prohibition in 22:26 is later dramatized as catastrophic collapse for one who associates partners in 22:31.
topics.reason: Rows explicitly link the command in 22:26 with the consequence image in 22:31.

topics.headline: negative then positive command pair
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the charter begins by excluding rival association before requiring sanctuary purification.
topics.reason: The prohibition and purification imperative are coordinated as two commands in the commission.

topics.headline: clipped prohibitive sound
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the jussive closure as a hard stop that suits the prohibition’s semantic cut-off.
topics.reason: The row observes the final consonantal closure of the canonical surface.

words.gloss_range: preposition with attached first-person divine pronoun marking the forbidden relation
words.prose: {{ar:بِ}} ({{tr:bi}}) is small, but with the attached pronoun it makes the prohibition relational: no thing may be partnered “with Me.” The divine self is named by direct speech rather than by a repeated title, and the preposition can cover both alongside-ness and domain. That grounds the sanctuary wrongdoing of 22:25 in a direct offense against the speaker.

topics.headline: with Me pronoun
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the prohibited partnership is directed toward the speaking divine “Me,” not a repeated title outside direct speech.
topics.reason: The preposition plus first-person pronoun is governed by the association verb.

topics.headline: accompaniment and domain
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ban covers anything set alongside God and anything introduced into God’s domain.
topics.reason: The preposition can support accompaniment and relational-domain force in this context.

topics.headline: wrongdoing narrowed to association
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the prior ayah’s wrongdoing against the sanctuary is grounded here in the foundational association-ban.
topics.reason: The boundary row connects 22:25 wrongdoing with the specific relational prohibition in 22:26.

words.gloss_range: indefinite accusative object giving the prohibition universal scope
words.root_gloss_range: broad {{ar:ش ي ء}} ({{tr:sh-y-ʾ}}) “thing” range used here as the most general object term
words.prose: {{ar:شَيْـًۭٔا}} ({{tr:shayʾan}}) seals the first command by refusing exceptions. As an indefinite accusative under prohibition, it means no thing whatsoever may enter the partnership relation. The common, stable {{ar:ش ي ء}} ({{tr:sh-y-ʾ}}) noun is exactly what gives the ban its total conceptual reach, and the final catch closes the universal object before the next command begins.

topics.headline: unrestricted anything
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the prohibition does not name rival classes because its object is maximally open: nothing whatsoever is allowed into partnership.
topics.reason: The indefinite accusative under prohibition produces universal scope; object and scope-accusative analyses both preserve that force.

topics.headline: closure sound
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the universal object close before the next command begins.
topics.reason: The row ties the final hamza closure to the end of the prohibition.

words.gloss_range: coordinating connector turning from prohibition to purification command
words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) carries the charter from barred association into commanded purification. It keeps the two speech acts connected, but it does not collapse them: first the divine relation is protected, then the House is actively purified for worshippers.

topics.headline: second command coordination
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that purification is a distinct second speech act joined to the prohibition rather than a restatement of it.
topics.reason: The conjunction coordinates the purification imperative with the completed negative command.

words.gloss_range: Form II imperative commanding active purification of the House
words.root_gloss_range: broad {{ar:ط ه ر}} ({{tr:ṭ-h-r}}) purity range including physical cleanliness and ritual sanctity, both active locally
words.prose: {{ar:طَهِّرْ}} ({{tr:ṭahhir}}) makes the second half of the commission an imperative addressed to the named patriarch. Form II turns purity into enacted work: make the concrete House pure, materially and ritually, for the worship system that follows. The command parallels 2:125, but 22:26 gives the instruction to that patriarch alone and pairs it with the prior ban on association.

topics.headline: direct imperative to {{ar:إِبْرَٰهِيمَ}} ({{tr:ibrāhīma}})
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the second command keeps {{ar:إِبْرَٰهِيمَ}} ({{tr:ibrāhīma}}) under direct divine address while changing the required action.
topics.reason: The verb is a second-person masculine singular imperative with the same recovered addressee.

topics.headline: physical and ritual purity
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the {{ar:ط ه ر}} ({{tr:ṭ-h-r}}) command joins material cleaning and sacral purity because the object is the concrete House.
topics.reason: The local concrete object prevents the root from becoming merely abstract while the lexical range includes ritual purity.

topics.headline: causative purification work
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that purity is commanded as work to be done, not described as a pre-existing state.
topics.reason: Form II imperative makes {{ar:إِبْرَٰهِيمَ}} ({{tr:ibrāhīma}}) the agent who makes the House pure.

topics.headline: singular House command
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that 22:26 gives {{ar:إِبْرَٰهِيمَ}} ({{tr:ibrāhīma}}) a singular command where 2:125 has a dual purification command to {{ar:إِبْرَٰهِيمَ}} ({{tr:ibrāhīma}}) and {{ar:إِسْمَٰعِيلَ}} ({{tr:ismāʿīla}}).
topics.reason: The rows explicitly compare the singular command in 22:26 with the dual command in 2:125.

topics.headline: purification mirrors association exclusion
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that conceptual exclusion of association and ritual-material purification of the House form the two halves of the charter.
topics.reason: The positive purification command follows the negative association command and opens the House-worship network.

words.gloss_range: the divine House as direct object of purification, with first-person possessive suffix
words.root_gloss_range: broad {{ar:ب ي ت}} ({{tr:b-y-t}}) dwelling/sanctuary range selected as God’s concrete House
words.prose: {{ar:بَيْتِىَ}} ({{tr:baytiya}}) is the object of the purification command: the House itself is to be made pure before the beneficiary list begins. The possessive suffix makes the known sanctuary from word 7 explicitly “My House,” so purification is grounded in divine ownership. That possessed House then becomes the center for circumambulation, including the later command in 22:29.

topics.headline: object before beneficiary
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the command first identifies what must be purified, then opens to those for whom it is purified.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence makes the House the object and the following phrase the beneficiary or purpose.

topics.headline: My House ownership
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the known sanctuary becomes explicitly God’s own House inside direct speech.
topics.reason: The first-person possessive suffix is fused to the House noun and preserved across variant-reading vowel variation.

topics.headline: center for circumambulation
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that “My House” is the center around which the following circumambulators and the later command in 22:29 turn.
topics.reason: The row explicitly links the House with the circumambulation field and 22:29.

topics.headline: ownership arc reprise
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the internal shift from “the House” to “My House,” making divine ownership the reason purification is obligatory.
topics.reason: The same root repeats from word 7 with stronger possessive marking at word 15.

words.gloss_range: purpose-benefactive preposition governing the worshipper list
words.prose: {{ar:لِ}} ({{tr:li}}) turns purification outward toward its beneficiaries and purpose. Its scope begins with the circumambulators but continues through the coordinated standing, bowing, and prostration terms. The repeated preposition also maps a chain of service: assignment for the named patriarch, purification for worshippers.

topics.headline: beneficiary scope over list
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that one purpose-beneficiary marker governs the whole worshipper sequence, not just the first group.
topics.reason: The preposition governs the first beneficiary and coordination carries that scope through the list.

topics.headline: cascading benefaction
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices a chain: God assigns for {{ar:إِبْرَٰهِيمَ}} ({{tr:ibrāhīma}}), then {{ar:إِبْرَٰهِيمَ}} ({{tr:ibrāhīma}}) purifies for worshippers.
topics.reason: The ayah has two corresponding prepositional beneficiary phrases, one at word 4 and one here.

words.gloss_range: definite active-participle plural: circumambulators as the first beneficiary class
words.root_gloss_range: broad {{ar:ط و ف}} ({{tr:ṭ-w-f}}) range of circling, visiting, patrolling, and group formation narrowed to ritual circumambulation around the House
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلطَّآئِفِينَ}} ({{tr:al-ṭāʾifīna}}) begins the beneficiary list with people defined by circling the House. The active participle makes circumambulation an identity, and the {{ar:ط و ف}} ({{tr:ṭ-w-f}}) field lets motion around a center become group formation. Locally the House context narrows the field to ritual circumambulation, which 22:29 later commands explicitly.

topics.headline: shared list marking
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the first worshipper noun opens a governed list rather than standing alone.
topics.reason: The genitive plural participates in the beneficiary chain under the preceding preposition.

topics.headline: circumambulation as identity
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the House is purified for a stable class defined by circling, not merely for people who once performed an event.
topics.reason: The active participle is used substantively as a definite plural class label.

topics.headline: circling forms community
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the {{ar:ط و ف}} ({{tr:ṭ-w-f}}) field can connect circular motion and group formation, while the House context selects ritual circumambulation.
topics.reason: Broader visiting, patrolling, and faction senses are narrowed by the House-beneficiary context.

topics.headline: House orbit and posture sequence
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the list starts with motion around the House and later continues toward stationary and lowered postures, with 22:29 making the circumambulation explicit.
topics.reason: The rows link the root to the House field, the same-surah command in 22:29, and the sequence of worship acts.

words.gloss_range: conjunction adding the standing class to the beneficiary list
words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) adds the standers without restarting the syntax. Because the preposition is not repeated, the connector extends one beneficiary chain; because it is present, it keeps the standing class distinct rather than letting it collapse into a modifier of the circumambulators.

topics.headline: second beneficiary connector
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that standing is added as a distinct coequal worship mode inside one governed beneficiary chain.
topics.reason: The conjunction coordinates the second definite plural with the first without repeating the preposition.

words.gloss_range: definite active-participle plural for standers, attendants, or maintainers in the worshipper list
words.root_gloss_range: broad {{ar:ق و م}} ({{tr:q-w-m}}) range of standing, maintaining, peoplehood, resurrection, sustenance, and station narrowed to sustained worship standing/service
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلْقَآئِمِينَ}} ({{tr:al-qāʾimīna}}) names the upright class in the beneficiary list. The {{ar:ق و م}} ({{tr:q-w-m}}) field is large, so the word can carry standing, attendance, and maintenance pressure, but its local form narrows that pressure to those whose stance or service belongs to the purified House. In the sequence it mediates between circling motion and the lowered bowing-prostration pair, with an echo of the Abrahamic station field in 2:125. The root’s stance and establishment range also has a liturgical form here, while 22:77 later turns related worship postures into direct commands.

topics.headline: standing and attendance pressure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that {{ar:ٱلْقَآئِمِينَ}} ({{tr:al-qāʾimīna}}) can carry prayer-standing, attendance, and maintenance pressure, while the beneficiary list keeps it a worshipper class.
topics.reason: The active participle and root range support sustained standing/service; local list context prevents the whole q-w-m field from expanding uncontrolled.

topics.headline: coequal list form
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices standing as a coequal beneficiary category matching the morphology of the surrounding worshipper labels.
topics.reason: The word is definite genitive masculine plural coordinated within the list.

topics.headline: station and House resonance
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the standers resonate with the standing-place or station field around {{ar:إِبْرَٰهِيمَ}} ({{tr:ibrāhīma}}) in 2:125 without making that echo the local parse.
topics.reason: The rows explicitly connect q-w-m language with House passages and the station field in 2:125.

topics.headline: upright middle in descent sequence
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices standing as the upright middle point between mobile circling and the lowered bowing-prostration pair.
topics.reason: The word’s list position follows circumambulation and precedes the final lowered postures.

topics.headline: surah stance thread
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the root’s stance and establishment field has a liturgical form here, while later 22:77 turns related worship postures into direct commands.
topics.reason: The rows supply same-surah recurrence and the 22:77 command connection.

words.gloss_range: conjunction adding the final bowing-prostration unit without repeating the governing preposition
words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) introduces the final unit of the worshipper list. It adds the bowing group to the earlier beneficiaries, but the absence of another connector before the prostration term lets the closing posture pair bind more compactly than the earlier coordinated items. The public access of 22:25 is thus specified as concrete worship postures.

topics.headline: final unit connector
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the last connector adds a final beneficiary unit while the two posture words after it bind more tightly to each other.
topics.reason: The conjunction coordinates the bowing group with the prior list, while no conjunction separates the bowing and prostration terms.

words.gloss_range: definite broken plural of bowers, closely bound to the following prostration term
words.root_gloss_range: broad {{ar:ر ك ع}} ({{tr:r-k-ʿ}}) bending/bowing range narrowed to worshipful bodily lowering
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلرُّكَّعِ}} ({{tr:al-rukkaʿi}}) shifts the list from sound plural participles into a dense broken plural. It still names agents of bowing, but its form gives the final group extra weight and physical lowering. Together with the prostration term, it forms a compact posture pair whose exact syntax can be close apposition or construct-like attachment; the sound movement into that final term suits the bodily descent, and later 22:77 turns these postures into direct commands.

topics.headline: compact bowing-prostration pair
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that bowing and prostration form a tighter final unit than the earlier list items, while the exact relation can be appositional, adjectival, or construct-like.
topics.reason: Shared definiteness and genitive environment license close attachment; the evidence supports ambiguity without forcing one parse.

topics.headline: dense broken plural bowers
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that {{ar:ٱلرُّكَّعِ}} ({{tr:al-rukkaʿi}}) is morphologically heavier than the previous sound plurals and names a concentrated class of bodily lowering.
topics.reason: The broken plural of an active-participle base names agents of bowing and keeps the bodily bending image live.

topics.headline: beneficiary posture becomes command
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the posture named as a beneficiary identity in 22:26 later becomes a direct communal command in 22:77.
topics.reason: The row explicitly links 22:26 with 22:77.

topics.headline: descent sound texture
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the movement into the final prostration word as part of the posture descent.
topics.reason: The sound row connects the consonantal transition with the movement from bowing to prostration.

words.gloss_range: definite gerund of prostration, closing the list as an act attached to the bowing group
words.root_gloss_range: broad {{ar:س ج د}} ({{tr:s-j-d}}) range of prostrating, prostrator, and place of prostration narrowed to the gerund act at closure
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلسُّجُودِ}} ({{tr:al-sujūdi}}) closes the ayah by naming the act of prostration, not another active-participle group. Its definite genitive form locks back onto the bowing group, so the final posture pair is compact. The {{ar:س ج د}} ({{tr:s-j-d}}) field connects the act to the place-of-prostration language of 22:25 and to the later command in 22:77, while the local sequence lands bodily from circling and standing into full prostration. The heavy closing sound of the posture pair matches that descent into prostration.

topics.headline: locked final attachment
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that prostration does not float loose; it locks back onto the bowing group as the close of the final unit.
topics.reason: The word is definite and genitive beside the preceding definite genitive posture noun.

topics.headline: act replaces actor label
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the list end by naming the act of prostration itself, so action absorbs the earlier agent-label pattern.
topics.reason: The local form is a gerund/verbal noun rather than an active participle like the earlier class nouns.

topics.headline: prostration defines sacred place
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the {{ar:س ج د}} ({{tr:s-j-d}}) act links the House to {{ar:مَسْجِد}} ({{tr:masjid}}) language and to the later prostration command in 22:77, while the local word remains the act of prostration.
topics.reason: The root links prostration, masjid-place language in 22:25, House fields, and the later command in 22:77; local morphology selects the gerund act.

topics.headline: embodied descent closure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the worshipper sequence landing from circling and standing through bowing into complete prostration.
topics.reason: The word closes the list after movement, uprightness, and bowing; the rows explicitly frame this as embodied descent.

topics.headline: weighty closing sound
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the final posture pair carry audible weight matching the bodily descent into prostration.
topics.reason: The sound rows connect the consonant sequence with the physical weight of bowing and prostration.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The construction بوأنا ... مكان البيت joins prepared emplacement to the commands not to associate anything and to purify My House.
baseline_models.mechanism: Abraham is installed at a deliberately prepared dwelling-place whose divine claim is undivided and whose condition is maintained for worshippers. Place, ownership, cleansing, and use form one commissioning mechanism.

activation_trace.role: Prepared lodging supplies the act of making the sacred location inhabitable and usable.
Place and established position give the commission a fixed spatial center.
Shelter and dwelling make the House a receiving habitat rather than an abstract marker.
Refusal of a divine partner establishes the House's undivided Godward dedication.
Removal of defilement supplies the continuing condition that makes the dedicated dwelling fit for use.

changed_reading.before: God identifies a site and separately orders Abraham to keep a sanctuary clean.
changed_reading.after: God commissions Abraham to establish an inhabitable, exclusively God-claimed center and keep it fit for its worshipping users.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The beneficiary list moves from الطائفين through القائمين to الركع السجود.
baseline_models.mechanism: The listed bodies organize a cleared field: circulation uses the perimeter, standing establishes an upright station, and bowing and prostration lower the body toward the ground. The list can therefore be read as spatial choreography as well as classes of worshippers.

activation_trace.role: Clearing defilement supplies an unobstructed field for the following bodily actions.
Circling supplies movement around a stable center.
Bodily uprightness supplies the stationary vertical phase.
Bending and lowering the head begin the descent from uprightness.
Full lowering and submission complete the movement toward the ground.

changed_reading.before: Purification prepares a static building for several named worshipper groups.
changed_reading.after: Purification clears a coordinated movement field extending from circuit, through upright station, to successive lowering.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: القائمين stands between circling and bending worshippers but its root inventory also carries care, preservation, and keeping an affair upright.
baseline_models.mechanism: Alongside the dominant postural reading, the standers may faintly include those who keep watch over, tend, or sustain the House's ordered use. The neighboring posture nouns constrain this to a secondary institutional activation.

activation_trace.role: Preparing a lodging implies an ongoing usable establishment, not only locating coordinates.
A dwelling supplies the institution whose hospitable condition must be sustained.
Care, preservation, and charge activate a custodial shade within the surface sense of standing.
Keeping the House free of defilement supplies the custodian's functional task.

changed_reading.before: The standers are only bodies occupying one prayer posture.
changed_reading.after: The standers may also carry a restrained echo of people who keep the House and its worship operational.

context_deltas.mechanism: Worship on an edge that reverses under trial supplies a spatial and affective anti-model to the focus's fixed place, centered circuit, and upright station. The House becomes a discipline of reorientation around a center rather than conditional balance at a margin.

activation_trace.role: A fixed place supplies the center against which marginal worship can be contrasted.
Ordered circling maintains relation to a center while the worshipper moves.
Upright standing supplies bodily stability without requiring immobility in every phase.
Inclination away from a direction supplies the unstable edge-position that the centered rites counter.
Turning something onto or away from its face supplies reversal when contingent worship fails.

structural_cues: 22:11 places worship explicitly on an edge and then depicts reversal upon trial.
22:26 combines a fixed place with movement that repeatedly preserves relation to one center.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies edge, reversal, fixed place, circuit, and standing; I infer an antithetical spatial pedagogy. A live alternative is that 22:11 only judges motivation and says nothing about the House's spatial function.

changed_reading.before: The posture sequence is a neutral inventory of rites performed at a sanctuary.
changed_reading.after: The sanctuary's centered movements train durable orientation against worship that balances conditionally at an edge and flips under pressure.

context_deltas.mechanism: The same prostration root is first distributed across beings and bodies in heaven and earth, then localized among the House's users. Human prostration at the House becomes a site-specific participation in a surah-wide cosmic submission.

activation_trace.role: The focus supplies embodied lowering and submission as the House's terminal posture.
The same lowering and submission extends across the preceding cosmic enumeration and scales the local act.

structural_cues: 22:18 enumerates heavens, earth, celestial bodies, terrain, vegetation, animals, and people under one prostration predicate.
22:26 later names prostrators as beneficiaries of a prepared terrestrial center.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies same-root prostration at cosmic and House scales; I infer local participation in the larger pattern, not literal pilgrimage by every enumerated nonhuman. The alternative is simple thematic repetition without a scale relation.

changed_reading.before: Prostrators are one human user class among others at the House.
changed_reading.after: Their local bodily descent stages, at one prepared center, the submission already attributed to the wider created order.

context_deltas.mechanism: The House's undivided divine claim is paired with rejection of obstruction, equality between resident and outsider, and arrivals through distant open passes. Purification thus acquires an access function: it clears both cultic encumbrance and human gatekeeping from a shared destination.

activation_trace.role: The partnership branch makes the prohibition relevant to claims of a divided stake or co-ownership.
The House as shelter supplies a receiving place for the distributed arrivals.
Turning people away supplies the concrete access failure opposed by the House's beneficiary construction.
Equality between two parties supplies the social rule for resident and visitor.
Repeated coming turns the House's users into an arriving public rather than a settled local constituency.
The open mountain pass supplies the long-range channels feeding movement toward the center.

structural_cues: 22:25 immediately precedes the focus with obstruction and explicit equality of resident and outsider.
22:27 answers the focus with a public summons and repeated arrivals from every distant pass.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies sole divine dedication, equal access, obstruction, and mass arrival; I infer that divine ownership dislodges local gatekeeping. Alternatively, access equality may be a separate legal consequence rather than semantic content of the no-partner command.

changed_reading.before: Purification protects a sacred interior for already identified worshippers.
changed_reading.after: Purification also protects an equally accessible receiving center whose users approach from outside every local ownership boundary.

context_deltas.mechanism: Avoiding the contaminating admixture of idols specifies one object of cleansing, while the contrast between meat and blood not reaching God and protective God-consciousness reaching Him prevents a merely material account. The purified House supports decontaminated allegiance and intention as well as a clean site.

activation_trace.role: Removal of dirt and defect supplies the concrete cleansing operation.
Purifying self and action from the blameworthy keeps an ethical scope live within the same imperative.
A contaminant that stains and mixes supplies the surah's concrete cultic pollution image.
The worshipped image identifies rival cultic objects as one contaminating admixture.
Repeated reaching distinguishes material offerings that do not arrive from the inward orientation that does.
Placing oneself under protection supplies the inward God-conscious orientation that gives ritual its effective direction.

structural_cues: 22:30 joins avoidance of idol-filth to avoidance of false speech.
22:37 explicitly denies that sacrificial flesh or blood reaches God and contrasts them with taqwa.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies idol-filth, a material/nonmaterial reaching contrast, and two purification branches; I infer cultic and ethical decontamination under one House command. The alternative restricts 22:26 to the sanctuary's physical state and treats later inward demands only as pilgrim conduct.

changed_reading.before: Purifying the House means removing visible dirt or forbidden objects.
changed_reading.after: Purifying the House means guarding a whole ritual ecology from rival objects, contaminating admixture, false performance, and materially reductive devotion.

context_deltas.mechanism: Repeated q-w-m forms describe people who establish prayer under ordinary hardship, communal power, and the final Abrahamic charge. The later anti-images of an emptied settlement and disabled well show what architecture without sustained right use becomes. Together they strengthen the custodial shade of the focus's standers.

activation_trace.role: Care, preservation, and charge supply the baseline possibility that standers also sustain worship.
Keeping prayer established turns root-level standing into durable religious maintenance.
Establishing prayer when empowered scales maintenance from individual posture to public institution.
Emptiness supplies the negative image of a built place deprived of living, ordered use.
Vacancy and disabling supply the anti-function of an untended communal resource.
The closing imperative to establish prayer confirms maintenance as the community's ongoing assignment.

structural_cues: The same root recurs in forms meaning keep or establish prayer at 22:35, 22:41, and 22:78.
22:45 juxtaposes an emptied settlement, an abandoned well, and an imposing palace.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies derivational q-w-m repetition and anti-images of nonuse; I infer that some force of sustaining worship feeds back into القائمين. The live alternative is that the focus participle remains posture-only despite the surah-wide root development.

changed_reading.before: Those standing are momentary occupants of one bodily posture.
changed_reading.after: Those standing also emerge as a community that keeps prayer and its hospitable center standing across time, power, and the risk of institutional vacancy.

context_deltas.mechanism: The singular divine claim over My House is later placed within a counterfactual defense of multiple named worship buildings where God's name is voiced. Exclusive devotion and architectural plurality are not collapsed: the Abrahamic House is one concentrated center within a protected ecology of remembrance.

activation_trace.role: The sacred dwelling supplies the focus's particular built center.
Undivided devotion fixes the theological criterion without itself requiring architectural singularity.
Demolition and collapse supply the threatened fate shared by the enumerated worship buildings.
A place of prostration links built worship space back to the House's prostrating beneficiaries.
Voicing remembrance on the tongue supplies the common protected function across the plural sites.

structural_cues: 22:40 places monasteries, churches, synagogues or prayers, and mosques in one anti-demolition sequence.
The stated common feature is abundant mention of God's name.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a particular House and a defended plurality of remembrance sites; I infer an ecology in which the House exemplifies concentrated sacred service rather than monopolizing all protected architecture. Alternatively, 22:40 may only justify defense without reframing 22:26.

changed_reading.before: The command establishes an isolated sacred building whose exclusivity mirrors exclusive devotion.
changed_reading.after: The command establishes a uniquely claimed center whose function remains legible inside a wider, divinely defended plurality of places of remembrance.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus's unrestricted anything is echoed in a miniature agency test: invoked rivals cannot create a fly or recover even a thing taken from them. The no-partner command becomes a refusal to assign divine co-agency where the smallest demonstrated act of making and recovery fails.

activation_trace.role: The divine-partner sense supplies the claim tested by the later parable.
The unrestricted knowable thing gives the prohibition maximal scope.
Origination supplies the first concrete capability that the invoked rivals fail.
The exact generic object root compresses the test from any possible partner to even one stolen item.
Failure to extract a thing from another's hold supplies the second failed capability.
Lack of strength diagnoses both seeker and sought in the rival-agency transaction.

structural_cues: 22:73 repeats the focus's ش ي ء root inside a parable about those invoked apart from God.
The parable tests both creative power and power to retrieve a minimal loss.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the exact thing echo and failed creation and recovery; I infer that the parable operationalizes the focus's ban on divine co-agency. Alternatively, the parable attacks invoked idols generally without specifically explaining the focus's indefinite object.

changed_reading.before: Do not associate anything is an absolute allegiance rule stated without an internal test.
changed_reading.after: The rule is later stress-tested at the scale of one fly and one recoverable thing: no proposed co-agent can perform even the minimal work its claim would require.

context_deltas.mechanism: The ending directly commands believers to bow and prostrate, names Abraham as their father and his way as followed, then commissions witness and established prayer. The focus's charge to one ancestor therefore opens into an inherited communal office: embody the rites, keep them established, and make them publicly witness-bearing.

activation_trace.role: The original prepared lodging supplies Abraham's founding commission.
Bowing supplies one beneficiary posture later addressed directly to the believing audience.
Prostration supplies the second posture revoiced as a closing imperative.
The command to bow turns a future House-user label into the audience's present action.
The command to prostrate completes the direct uptake of the focus's paired postures.
Selection and drawing near supply the community's commissioning for the inherited work.
A followed religious way supplies continuity rather than mere biological recollection.
Fatherhood and formation make Abraham's founding role genealogically and pedagogically active.
Knowledge-bearing testimony supplies the outward public function of the inherited practice.
Establishing and maintaining prayer turns inherited posture into durable communal order.

structural_cues: 22:77 repeats the focus's bowing and prostration roots as direct imperatives to believers.
22:78 names Abraham as father, invokes his followed way, commissions witness, and commands establishment of prayer.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies exact posture repetition, Abrahamic lineage, selection, witness, and established prayer; I infer continuity of commission from founder to community. A live alternative is that fatherhood marks religious ancestry without transferring any House-specific office.

changed_reading.before: Abraham prepares the House for an unspecified later population of worshippers.
changed_reading.after: The surah's final audience recognizes itself as that Abrahamic population, inheriting the work through enacted posture, sustained prayer, and witness before humanity.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates the hunter's-snare branch of ش ر ك rather than treating it as the focus's direct lexical gloss. It remains anchored by the same root, the focus's free circling around a center, and 22:31's same-root fall, seizure, and remote displacement. Downstream prose should present it only as a spatial metaphorical echo, not as a replacement translation of لا تشرك.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus juxtaposes لا تشرك with unobstructed circling around a prepared center.

activation_trace.role: A hunter's entangling device supplies a deliberately branch-distant image for compromised allegiance.
Free ordered circling supplies the movement that entanglement would derail.
The repeated association root keeps the snare image attached to the surah's explicit anti-association simile.
Swift seizure supplies the loss of controlled movement after centered relation breaks.
Falling into an abyss supplies uncontrolled vertical movement opposite the focus's ordered lowering.
Extreme distance supplies displacement away from the prepared center.

changed_reading.before: Association is only the propositional act of naming a divine partner.
changed_reading.after: As a contained spatial echo, association behaves like entanglement that converts centered circulation and voluntary lowering into seizure, fall, and dispersal.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is a cross-domain analogy between sanctuary cleansing and the later removal of an intrusive casting from prophetic communication. It remains anchored in طهر, the undivided House, and the packet's explicit remove-then-secure process, but 22:52 does not identify revelation with architecture. Downstream prose should qualify it as a process analogy about protected containers, never as a claim that the verses share one literal referent.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: طهر بيتي commands removal of what compromises a divinely claimed receiving space.

activation_trace.role: Removal of contaminant supplies the focus-side filtering operation.
The dwelling supplies a bounded receiving environment whose intended use can be protected.
Casting something in supplies the intrusive input in the comparison.
Removal followed by replacement supplies an explicit filtering step.
Making firm and secure supplies the stabilized state after removal.

changed_reading.before: House purification is only cleaning a physical sanctuary.
changed_reading.after: As a qualified process analogy, it is also protection of a commissioned container: foreign insertion is removed so the intended divine ordering remains firm.

strongest_changes: The House's sole divine claim becomes the ground for equal human access rather than local possession.
Purification expands from visible cleanliness to cultic and ethical decontamination without dissolving its material sense.
The standers become plausible maintainers who keep prayer and the House's use established against vacancy.
The closing bowing, prostration, Abrahamic fatherhood, witness, and established prayer turn the founding commission into an inherited communal office.
summary.what_was_special: The whole-surah packet made the focus operate simultaneously as centered movement, public access institution, protected worship site, and Abrahamic witness-training commission; distant same-root returns changed several apparently static nouns and postures into durable social functions.
remaining_uncertainties: The custodial force in القائمين is strongly activated by later q-w-m forms but remains secondary to the immediate postural syntax.
The link from exclusive divine ownership to equal human access is a reader-supplied legal-social arrow, not an explicit causal statement in 22:26.
The snare and filtered-container outliers are useful only under explicit metaphorical and cross-domain containment.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **Prepared place generates ordered bodily relations.** `ب و ء B001` supplies settling and preparing an abode; `ب ي ت B001` shelter; `ط ه ر B001/B005` removal of defilement from place and conduct; `ط و ف B001`, `ق و م B002`, `ر ك ع B001`, and `س ج د B001` supply circling, standing, bending, and lowering. I infer that purifying the house makes distinct motions cohere around a single center. The verse reads as architectural preparation for an integrated ritual body.
2. **No partnership means no divided center.** `ش ر ك B001/B002` supplies sharing and associating a partner, while *shayʾan* uses `ش ي ء B001` in maximally open scope. The prohibition precedes purification and the ordered motions. I infer that a shared divine center would fragment the geometry of worship. Non-association therefore reads not only doctrinally but spatially as preserving one orienting center for every participant.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 22:77 repeated bowing and prostration before commanding general good, showing that this house's ordered motions are training for beneficent agency.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **A location is prepared as a choreography of bodies.** Fixed `بَوَّأْنَا` activates `ب و ء:B001` (settling and preparing a place), `ٱلْبَيْت` activates `ب ي ت:B001` (shelter and dwelling), and `طَهِّر` activates `ط ه ر:B001` (defilement removed) with `B005` (conduct cleansed from blame). The beneficiaries are defined by `ط و ف:B001` (circling), `ق و م:B002` (upright standing), `ر ك ع:B001` (bending), and `س ج د:B001` (lowering). `22:25` supplied equal access and `22:27` supplies mass arrival. The packet gives prepared place and coordinated movements; I infer that purification preserves the site's capacity to host these orientations. The House reads as public ritual infrastructure, not merely a sacred object.
2. **Non-partnership protects the center from divided claims.** Fixed `تُشْرِك` activates `ش ر ك:B001` (sharing and partnership) and `B002` (associating a partner with God). Because all listed motions organize around one House, I infer that divided divine claims would fracture the common center. The prohibition therefore has a spatial-social role: it keeps the place's many users oriented through one relation.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: Later `22:27` fills the purified House with converging routes, and `22:28` fills those routes with witnessing and feeding. The place's purity therefore protects both movement and redistribution.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak anlatımı, bir şeyin gerçekleşip bulunur hale gelmesini çekirdek kabul eder ve buna olma adları ile geçmiş ya da şimdiki bildirme kullanımlarını bağlar. Pekiştirme, ayırma ve ettirgen oluşturma kullanımları aynı dal içinde bağımlı kullanımlar olarak durur; yer, konum ve üstlenme dalları bu çekirdeğin yerine geçirilmez.

Olma ve oluş adları bu çekirdeğin adlaştırılmış biçimleridir.
Geçmişteki bir durumun haber verilmesi veya şimdiki olmanın bildirilmesi bu alana bağlıdır.
Pekiştirme ve gelen kişiyi kapsam dışı bırakma gibi bağlı söz dizimleri çekirdeğe ek kullanımlardır.
Bir şeyi oldurmak, onun gerçekleşmesini sağlama yönünde ettirgen bir uzantıdır.

concept_map.definition: Bir şeyin, hakkın ya da işin iki veya daha çok taraf arasında bulunması ve hiçbir tarafın onda tek başına olmamasıdır. Taraflardan biri diğerine katılabilir ya da onu aynı iş veya mülkiyet ilişkisine katabilir.

facets.statement: Bir şey, hak veya iş en az iki taraf arasında ortaktır ve taraflardan yalnız birine ait değildir.
Ortaklık, tarafların aynı mülkiyet veya anlam ilişkisi içinde birleşmesini ve birbirine katılmasını içerir.
Bir kimse bir başkasını işe, satışa veya mirasa kendisiyle birlikte dahil ederek ortak yapabilir.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi aynı yol söz varlığı altında yolun belirgin izlerini veya geniş şeritlerini, ana ya da orta bölümünü ve ondan ayrılan küçük kolları bir araya getirir. Geçici çerçevedeki otlak yolları yalnız ayrı bir sözcük biriminde bulunur ve dal iddiasını belirlemediği için ana tanımdan çıkarılmıştır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal, yolun ana yatağı, izleri ve küçük kolları gibi yapısal bölümlerle sınırlıdır; her tür yol veya otlakta bulunan her patika bu dala girmez.

lexicalization_scope.note: Dal, yol bağlamına bağlı adları ve özel yol bölümü kullanımlarını içerir; bunlar yalın kökün bağımsız genel anlamı olarak birleştirilmez.

concept_map.definition: Bir yolun ana veya orta kesimini, belirgin oluk ve geniş izlerini ve ana yoldan ayrılan küçük kollarını adlandıran yol yapısı anlamıdır. Kaynak anlatımları tek bir geometrik parçadan çok bu bağlantılı yol bölümleri arasında değişir.

facets.statement: Söz, yolun belirgin oluklarını, geniş izlerini veya geçiş şeritlerini adlandırabilir.
Bazı anlatımlarda yolun ana, büyük veya orta bölümü öne çıkar.
Ana yoldan ayrılıp bir süre sonra sona eren küçük yol kolları da aynı ad ailesiyle ifade edilir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Toplu kaynak ifadesi yolun oluk ve şeritleri, ana ya da orta bölümü ve bu ana bölümden ayrılan küçük kollar arasında değişen, fakat yolun yapısına bağlı bir anlam alanı gösterir.

concept_gloss.text: yolun ana yatağı, izleri ve küçük kolları
concept_gloss.applicability: Yolun kendisinden çok ana kesimi, üzerindeki belirgin geçiş izleri ve ondan ayrılan küçük yolları birlikte açıklamak için uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Ana veya orta yol bölümünü, iz ve olukları ve küçük dallanan yolları birlikte korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Söz yolun büyük ya da orta bölümünü veya bu bölümdeki belirgin oluk ve şeritleri gösterdiğinde kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Yolun ana kesimi ile belirgin yüzey izlerini korur.
error_profile.loses: Ana yoldan ayrılan küçük kolları kapsamaz.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Söz ana yolun küçük, dallanan ve sonunda kesilebilen kollarını gösterdiğinde uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Ana yoldan ayrılan küçük kol yollarını açık biçimde korur.
error_profile.loses: Ana yolun kendisini, orta kesimini ve yüzey oluklarını kapsamaz.

lexical_glosses.target_gloss: yolun ana yatağı, ortası veya izleri
otlağın yollar veya izler halinde uzanması

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Yolun ana veya orta kesimini ve ondan ayrılan küçük kolları da adlandırır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Yol sözüyle birlikte özellikle yolun iz ve oluklarını başka bir ad altında öne çıkarır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal yolun görünür izlerini ve oluklarını adlandırma alanında örtüşür.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal izlerden ana yol kesimine ve küçük kollara uzanan daha geniş bir yapısal kümeyi taşır; komşu dalın ortak bölgesi daha çok yol ve yol izleridir.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Yolun ana yatağındaki izleri, orta bölümünü ve küçük dallarını bölüm olarak adlandırır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Gidilmek istenen açık veya belirgin yolu bütün olarak adlandırır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal da belirgin ve yürünebilir bir yol alanına ilişkindir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal yolun iç yapısını ve kollarını gösterir; komşu dal ise yolun kendisini, özellikle açık ve amaçlanan güzergâhı gösterir.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Tüm yol ve kök içi adaylar değerlendirildi; yol izleriyle en yakın örtüşen dal ve yolun bütününü anlatan dal yayımlandı, kalan adaylar yalnız genel güzergâh veya uzak yüzey özellikleri sundu.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi avın içine dolanıp kaldığı avcı kapanını açıkça tanımlar ve dünya için kurulan tuzak benzetmesini buna bağlar. Geçici çerçevedeki belirli bir kuş için kurulma ayrıntısı yetkili dal ifadesinde bulunmadığından tanıma alınmamıştır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Çekirdek, avın yakalandığı bağ veya ağ biçimli kapan; genişleme ise bunun tuzak anlamındaki benzetmesidir. Belirli bir av türü zorunlu değildir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Dal avcı kapanının adını ve bu nesneden türeyen dünya tuzağı kullanımını ayırır; mecaz fiziksel kapanın kurucu tanımına dönüştürülmez.

concept_map.definition: Avcının kurduğu, avın içine dolanarak veya takılarak kurtulamadığı bağ ya da ağ biçimli kapandır. Aynı yakalama görüntüsü, insanı içine çeken dünya tuzağı için benzetme yoluyla kullanılabilir.

facets.statement: Avcı, avın içine dolanıp yakalandığı bağ veya ağ biçimli bir kapan kurar.
Fiziksel kapan görüntüsü, insanı yakalayıp kendine bağlayan dünya için benzetmeli olarak kullanılır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Ortak çekirdek, avın dolanarak yakalandığı avcı kapanıdır; toplu ifade ayrıca bu kapan görüntüsünün dünyaya ilişkin tuzak benzetmesine genişlediğini gösterir.

concept_gloss.text: avın dolandığı kapan ve tuzak benzetmesi
concept_gloss.applicability: Fiziksel av kapanını ve bu kapanın insanı kendine çeken bir şeye benzetilmesini birlikte temsil eden açıklayıcı karşılıktır.

error_profile.preserves: Avın dolanıp kalmasını, avcı tarafından kurulmayı ve benzetmeli tuzak genişlemesini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Söz, avcının kurduğu ve avın içine dolanarak yakalandığı fiziksel aracı gösterdiğinde kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Avcının kurduğu yakalama aracını ve avın yakalanma sonucunu korur.
error_profile.loses: Dünya için kullanılan benzetmeli tuzak anlamını kapsamaz.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Fiziksel kapanın yakalayıcı niteliği dünyaya veya dünya hayatına benzetme yoluyla aktarıldığında uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Bir şeyin insanı yakalayıp kendine bağlaması yönündeki benzetmeyi korur.
error_profile.loses: Gerçek av aracının biçimini ve avcılık bağlamını doğrudan karşılamaz.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Avın içine dolandığı bağ veya ağ biçimli kapanı ve dünya tuzağı benzetmesini taşır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Av kapanlarının daha geniş sınıfını, avlanma eylemini ve ölüm ya da kötülük nedenlerine uzanan başka benzetmeleri kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.gloss: özel av ağı ile genel av kapanı
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal avcının kurduğu ve avı yakalayan kapan alanında doğrudan örtüşür.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal dolanma biçimli belirli kapan görüntüsüne bağlıdır; komşu dal araç, avlanma ve benzetmeli kullanım bakımından daha geniştir.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Dolanma veya takılma yoluyla yakalayan bağ ya da ağ yapısını ve dünya benzetmesini belirtir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Av için kurulmuş kapanı biçimini ayrıntılandırmadan genel bir tuzak olarak adlandırır.
neighbor_distinctions.gloss: dolanmalı av kapanı ile genel tuzak
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal da avı yakalamak üzere önceden kurulan bir kapanı gösterir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dalda avın bağlara dolanması belirgindir ve mecaz dünyaya uzanır; komşu dal daha genel kurulmuş kapan kavramında kalır.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün kapan, avlanma ve kök içi adaylar incelendi; en yakın genel kapan alanları sınır karşılaştırması için seçildi, yalnız avlanma aracını veya yakalanma olayını uzaktan paylaşan adaylar yayımlanmadı.
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه حبالة الصائد التي يرتبك فيها الصيد؛ وما ينصب للحمام؛ الاستعمال المجازي للحبالة
branches.what_is_not_ar: ليس هو شراك النعل؛ ولا شرك الطريق؛ ولا الشرك بالله إلا من جهة المجاز المذكور
branches.source_phrase_ar: شرك الصائد سمي بذلك لامتداده (maqayis)؛ الشرك حبالة يرتبك فيها الصيد (ayn)؛ الشرك بالتحريك حبالة الصائد (sihah)؛ شرك الصائد حبالته يرتبك فيها الصيد (tahdhib)؛ شرك الدنيا أي حبالتها (mufradat)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi iki özel yapıda aynı ardışıklık niteliğini verir: hızlı ve peş peşe gelen tokatlar ile bir gelişin ardından gelen başka geliş. Dalın art arda oluş kimliği, bu yapılara bağlı tutulduğu sürece kaynakla uyumludur.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Anlam yalnız belirtilen tokatlama ve geliş sırası kullanımlarında art ardalığı bildirir; yalın ve genel bir süreklilik sözü olarak genişletilmez.

lexicalization_scope.note: Dal yalnız belirli niteleme yapılarında tanıklanmıştır; tanım art ardalık çekirdeğini korurken onu yalın kökün bağımsız anlamı saymaz.

concept_map.definition: Belirli niteleme yapılarında bir vuruşun veya gelişin ardından benzerinin peş peşe gelmesini anlatır. Tokatlarda hızlılık da bu ardışıklığa eşlik eder.

facets.statement: Benzer olaylar biri diğerinin ardından art arda gerçekleşir.
Tokatlama bağlamında vuruşların peş peşe gelmesine hızlılık niteliği de eklenir.
Başka bir özel kullanımda bir suya gelişin ardından yeni bir gelişin gelmesi anlatılır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynak ifadesi art arda gelme niteliğini hızlı tokat dizisi ve bir gelişten sonra gelen başka geliş örnekleriyle sınırlandırılmış biçimde sunar.

concept_gloss.text: özel yapılarda hızlı ve art arda oluş
concept_gloss.applicability: Peş peşe tokatları ve birbiri ardından gerçekleşen gelişleri ortak ardışıklık niteliği altında açıklamak için kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Yapıya bağlılığı, peş peşe oluşu ve tokat bağlamındaki hızlılığı birlikte korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Tokatların kısa aralıklarla peş peşe geldiği özel vuruş nitelemesinde kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Tokatların hızlı ve peş peşe gelmesini tam olarak korur.
error_profile.loses: Bir gelişin ardından başka gelişin olması kullanımını kapsamaz.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir suya gelişin ardından başka bir gelişin gerçekleştiği sıra bağlamında uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Olayların biri diğerini izleyerek art arda gerçekleşmesini korur.
error_profile.loses: Tokatlama bağlamını ve oradaki hızlılık niteliğini kapsamaz.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Art ardalığı hızlı tokat ve peş peşe geliş bildiren özel yapılarda ifade eder.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Nesne ve eylemlerin ara vermeden sürmesini yapı veya olay türünden bağımsız genel olarak anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.gloss: özel art ardalık ile genel kesintisiz sıra
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dalda da bir olayın ardından benzer bir olayın gelmesi temel ortak alandır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal belirli söz yapıları ve olay örnekleriyle sınırlıdır; komşu dal ise ara vermeden birbirini izlemeyi genel bir süreç olarak adlandırır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Tek tek vuruş veya gelişlerin peş peşe olmasını özel niteleme olarak bildirir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Hayvan, insan veya toplulukların bölük bölük ve kafileler halinde gelmesini de kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.gloss: peş peşe oluş ile bölük bölük geliş
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal, birden çok gelişin zaman içinde birbirini izlemesi bakımından örtüşür.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal olayların doğrudan ardışıklığını niteler; komşu dal ise birbirini izleyen ayrı topluluk veya sürü kümelerini öne çıkarabilir.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün ardışıklık adayları ve kök içi dallar değerlendirildi; genel kesintisiz sıra ile bölük bölük geliş en yararlı iki sınırı verdi, diğer adaylar aynı art ardalık karşılaştırmasını tekrarladı.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi tek bir ortak görüşü değil, kaygılı biri gibi kendi kendine konuşan kişiyi ve tek çizgide olmayan, bölünmüş görüşü anlatan iki kullanımı birlikte verir. Bu nedenle dal, paylaşılan görüş olarak değil iç konuşma ve görüş birliğinin bozulmasıyla ilişkili iki yapı olarak yeniden çerçevelenmiştir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal, kişi için kaygılı iç konuşma ve görüş için tek olmama niteliklerini ayırır; insanlarca birlikte benimsenen ortak görüş anlamını taşımaz.

lexicalization_scope.note: Dal kişi ve görüş hakkında kullanılan iki bağlı yapıyı ayırır; ikisi de yalın kökün genel ortaklık anlamına dönüştürülmez.

concept_map.definition: Kişi hakkında kullanıldığında kaygılı biri gibi kendi kendine konuşup iç düşüncesiyle meşgul olmayı; görüş hakkında kullanıldığında ise görüşün tek ve birleşik olmayıp bölünmesini anlatır. İki kullanım aynı değildir ve bağlamlarına göre ayrılır.

facets.statement: Kişi, kaygılı biri gibi kendi kendine konuşur ve iç düşüncesiyle meşgul görünür.
Görüşe uygulandığında söz, görüşün tek ve birleşik olmayıp birden çok yöne bölünmüş olduğunu bildirir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Toplu ifade iki bağlama bağlı görünüm sunar: kaygılı biçimde kendi kendine konuşan kişi ve tek bir çizgide birleşmeyen, bölünmüş görüş.

concept_gloss.text: kaygılı iç konuşma veya bölünmüş görüş
concept_gloss.applicability: Kişi yüklemindeki kendi kendine konuşma ile görüş yüklemindeki tek olmama anlamını birbirine karıştırmadan birlikte gösteren açıklayıcı karşılıktır.

error_profile.preserves: Kişinin kaygılı iç konuşmasını ve görüşün birlikten yoksun oluşunu ayrı ayrı korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Söz, düşünceli veya kaygılı görünerek kendi kendine konuşan bir kişiyi nitelediğinde kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Kişinin kaygılı görünümünü ve kendi kendine konuşmasını korur.
error_profile.loses: Görüşün tek olmayıp bölünmesi kullanımını kapsamaz.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Söz bir kişinin görüşünün tek ve tutarlı bir yönde birleşmediğini bildirdiğinde uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Görüşün tek olmaması ve farklı yönlere ayrılması niteliğini korur.
error_profile.loses: Kendi kendine konuşan kişi kullanımını kapsamaz.

error_profile.preserves: Görüşle ilgili bir niteleme bulunduğu izlenimini kısmen korur.
error_profile.loses: Görüşün tek olmayıp bölünmüş olması ve kişinin kendi kendine konuşması anlamlarını yitirir.
error_profile.adds: Birden çok kişinin aynı görüşü paylaştığı anlamını ekler.
error_profile.collision: Çağdaş kullanımda insanlarca birlikte benimsenen görüş anlamıyla karışır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Kaygılı kendi kendine konuşmayı veya görüşün tek olmayıp bölünmesini bildirir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Görüş oluşturma, düşünme, bilme, tasarlama ve danışma süreçlerinin genel alanını kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal kişinin zihinsel uğraşı ve görüşüyle ilişkilidir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal zihinsel içeriğin bölünmesi veya dışa vurulan iç konuşmayla ilgilidir; komşu dal ise görüş ve düşünme yetisini olumlu ya da nötr biçimde genel olarak adlandırır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Kendi kendine konuşma davranışını ve görüşün tek olmamasını ayrı yapılarla belirtir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Belirli bir konuşma veya görüş yapısı gerektirmeden doğrudan şaşkınlık ve kararsızlık durumunu anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Kaygılı iç konuşma veya bölünmüş görüş, kararsızlık ve şaşkınlıkla birlikte görülebilir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal davranış ve görüş niteliği üzerinden tanımlanır; komşu dalın çekirdeği ise kişinin doğrudan şaşırıp ne yapacağını bilememesidir.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün görüş, düşünme, şaşkınlık ve kök içi adaylar incelendi; genel görüş alanı ile doğrudan şaşkınlık en yararlı sınırları sağladı, diğer adaylar yalnız dolaylı çağrışım taşıdı.
